faqs.q: What is the 45° Flange Code 61 Hose Fitting and which SAE J518 code is it?
faqs.a: The 45° Flange Code 61 Hose Fitting is a Code 61 Flange-on-Fitting per SAE J518 Code 61 (standard-pressure, up to 210 bar / 3000 psi), 45° elbow configuration. It is listed in 13 part numbers, size range 1/2" – 5". See all [SAE flange fittings](/c/sae-flange-fittings).

faqs.q: What are the part numbers of the 45° Flange Code 61 Hose Fitting?
faqs.a: Each IH-FL-61-45 part number in the 45° Flange Code 61 Hose Fitting table is one size; for example IH-FL-61-45-0808 and IH-FL-61-45-3232. The table lists the flange size and the dimensions for each.

faqs.q: What sizes does the 45° Flange Code 61 Hose Fitting come in?
faqs.a: The 45° Flange Code 61 Hose Fitting covers 1/2" – 5" in 13 part numbers. Sizes correspond to the flange port on the equipment side, such as a pump, valve or cylinder.

faqs.q: Which hose sizes go with which flange sizes on the 45° Flange Code 61 Hose Fitting?
faqs.a: The size table pairs a hose size with a flange size per row, for example 1/2" hose with a 1/2" flange, 1" hose with a 1-1/4" flange and 2" hose with a 2" flange. Pick the row that matches your hose bore and the port on the equipment.

faqs.q: What pressure and temperature is the 45° Flange Code 61 Hose Fitting rated for?
faqs.a: The 45° Flange Code 61 Hose Fitting is rated up to 210 bar (3000 psi), with an operating temperature of -40°C to +120°C. The pressure rating is set by the SAE J518 Code 61 series, and the rating of the assembly is the lowest-rated part, so the hose must match.

faqs.q: What is the 45° Flange Code 61 Hose Fitting made from, and is stainless steel available?
faqs.a: The 45° Flange Code 61 Hose Fitting is carbon steel with a zinc-plated, Cr3+ passivated, RoHS-compliant finish. Stainless steel (316) is available on request for marine, chemical or food-grade service; tell us the environment if you need it quoted.

faqs.q: Which standards and bolt pattern does the 45° Flange Code 61 Hose Fitting follow?
faqs.a: The 45° Flange Code 61 Hose Fitting is listed to SAE J518 Code 61, ISO 6162-1, with the bolt pattern SAE J518 Code 61 4-bolt; bolts SAE J429 Grade 5 minimum. SAE J518 Code 61 is the standard-pressure four-bolt flange series (ISO 6162-1); Code 61 and Code 62 parts do not interchange.
